step 3 Preparation of highly, synchronized cultures at the ring stage: The cultures of Plasmodium falciparum are synchronized at the ring stage by three successive exposures to 5% D-sorbitol. Expose asynchronous PfRBCs to 5% (w/v) D-sorbitol (Sigma-Aldrich) for 5 min. After washing with basal medium by centrifugation for 6 min at 500g, adjust the parasitemia to 0.8%–1.2% by adding uninfected RBCs, dispense into 24-well culture plates at a hematocrit of 2%, and cultured for 41 h. At 41-h culture, expose the PfRBCs to 5% D-sorbitol (the 2nd exposure), wash, and culture for further 5 h. At the total 46-h culture, expose the PfRBCs to 5% D-sorbitol (the 3rd exposure). After the 3rd sorbitol treatment, remove residual schizonts and cell debris by isopycnic density centrifugation for 10 min at 800g on 63% Percoll PLUS* (GE Healthcare Bio-Science Corp., Tokyo, Japan). *3.5 ml 90% Percoll PLUS + 1.5 ml PBS 90% Percoll PLUS is prepared by admixing 100% Percoll PLUS (9 parts) with 1.5 M NaCl (10x physiological saline) (1 part). Note: Periods for growth to the schizont stage are somewhat variable among strains. Culture periods useful for the protocol should be confirmed beforehand.

steps.title: Prepare Alsever's solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 4.1 g glucose, 0.84 g NaCl, 1.6 g Na₃‑citrate·2H₂O, and 0.11 g citric acid in 200 mL distilled water; autoclave the mixture; store for adding to whole blood or RBCs at a ratio of 1:1 to 1:4.

steps.title: Preserve erythrocytes in Alsever's
steps.instruction: Mix freshly collected erythrocytes with the prepared Alsever's solution and keep at 4 °C for 3 – 30 days.

steps.title: Wash preserved erythrocytes
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the preserved RBCs for 10 min at 800 g, discard supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in fresh buffer.

steps.title: Set up Plasmodium cultures
steps.instruction: Combine washed RBCs with Plasmodium falciparum‑infected RBCs, dispense 1 mL of the suspension into each well of a 24‑well plate to obtain a 2 % hematocrit, and incubate in a humidified atmosphere of 5 % CO₂, 5 % O₂, and 90 % N₂ at 37 °C.

substeps.instruction: Adjust parasitemia to 0.1 % for subculture or 0.3 % for growth tests by adding uninfected RBCs.
If needed, bring the hematocrit back to 2 % by adding the appropriate volume of culture medium.
